boundary: Reference compositions only. All names, text, costs, fill ratios and control states bind to canonical runtime models. Illustrations are independent raster layers.
coordinates: Boxes in vector-manifest.json are SVG viewBox units. Percentage CSS boxes are [x/width,y/height,w/width,h/height] times100. Keep icon drawing size separate from the44px input target.

handDraftRewardSmith: optional clipped parchment over fallback header/footer
deckTile: portrait illustration clipped to art well
live hexagonal cost and footer copy
panelInventoryHistoryLobby: focus ring on actual HTML control
layerRules.inlineSvg: Use svg-utils.namespaceSvg with a unique prefix per inline instance. External SVG images are independently scoped.
